items.description: Cortis reached 500 million streams on Spotify with its second EP “Greengreen,” label Big Hit Music said Wednesday. The six-track EP accomplished the feat in about five months. The album rolled out in May and sold more than 2.3 million units in its first week. So far, it has sold over 4.3 million copies and is the second K-pop act released this year, following BTS’ fifth LP “Arirang,” to exceed 4 million in sales. “GreenGreen” debuted at No. 3 on the Billboard 200 and spent 18 weeks on the chart.
